page.layout: One printed page (page 142). Running head at top centre. Main text in one block. Left of the text, a column of braced groups with grammatical labels (TI, SI, EI, NE) and their paradigms; these are a column of their own, placed before the running text. Below the braces, running prose continues at full width, ending with a page-number-like marker VI at lower right.

main_text.l: Te: Tibatte, & Battetti: verbera- uit te.
TI Tibi: Ti Diéde, & Diédeti: dedit tibi.
Se: Si vccíse, & Vccísesi: se interemit.
SI Sibi: Si diéde, & Diédesi lamórte: sibi mortem consciuit.
Nos: Ci percósse, & Percósseti: Nos percussit.
EI Nobis: Ci diéde & diédeci: Dedit nobis.
Illic, vel illuc: Cisu, Fúcci: illic fuit. Ciandó, andócci: iuit illuc.
main_text.p: Illud tamen hîc est animaduerten- dum, has particulas nonnunquam po- ni in oratione ornatus gratia dūtaxat: vt, Io micredo, pro Io credo: Tu ti pénsi, pro Tu pénsi: E' gli si crede: pro E'gli crede. Ac Boccatius ita est loquutus: Natural cósa, è di ciascúno, che ci násce, pro che násce.
main_text.l: NE Nos: Ne abbraccio, Abbracciónne: osculatus est nos
Nobis: Ne diéde, diédene: dedit nobis.

page.notes: Braces with labels TI, SI, EI, NE at left are paradigm column; the final "VI" at lower right is a printed mark, transcribed as is. Several Italian forms in the paradigm are set in small italic and possibly misread; marked by sense. Left margin shows faint show-through from the reverse page, omitted.
